react.description: A non-interactive label that groups the `NavigationRailItem`s following it.

tags.devx: - Section labels only render when the rail is extended.
tags.a11y:
- Renders as plain text with no role or heading semantics; it is announced
  like any other static text, not as a group label for assistive tech.
tags.limitations:
- Purely visual: it does not group its items in an ARIA sense (no
  `role="group"`/`aria-labelledby` wiring).

angular.description:
A non-interactive label that groups the `udx-navigation-rail-item`s
following it.

tags.devx:
- Section labels, and any item placed after one, only render while the
  rail is extended.
tags.a11y: - Renders as plain text with no role or heading semantics.
tags.limitations:
- Purely visual: it does not group its items in an ARIA sense (no
  `role="group"`/`aria-labelledby` wiring).
